name: Soft Game Fundamentals (60 min)
description: Builds control at the kitchen line: dinks, drops and resets, finishing with live play.

drills.name: Warm-up dinks
drills.instructions: Straight-ahead dinks with a partner. Start slow, then gradually add movement.

drills.name: Cross-court dinks
drills.target: 80% land in the kitchen and stay low
drills.instructions: Dink diagonally. Paddle up and out front, lift from the legs, finish toward your target. Count a miss for anything that pops up or lands out of the kitchen.

drills.name: Third-shot drops from the baseline
drills.instructions: Partner at the kitchen feeds deep. Drop with a smooth low-to-high swing and aim for the apex on your side of the net.

drills.name: Transition-zone resets
drills.target: Reset lands in the kitchen without popping up
drills.instructions: Stand mid-court. Partner drives medium-pace balls at you. Soften your grip and absorb the pace back into the kitchen.

drills.name: Drop, then move up
drills.instructions: Hit a drop, take 2–3 steps forward, split-step, then hit a reset. Repeat until you reach the kitchen line.

drills.name: Skinny singles (soft game only)
drills.target: Win the point by patience, not power
drills.instructions: Half-court games to 11, below-the-waist shots only. Record points won as Made and points lost as Miss.
